purpose: Requirements index for the existing production standard, not another tracker or client-fact store. Each job loads the current list and records actual evidence in its existing release record.

rules.requirement: Load the exact client's existing asset library and approval/feedback decisions before footage, graphics or music. Reuse the established standard; no fresh broad brand search when the known asset exists.

Refresh only new instructions, changed/missing asset versions and task-scoped mutable facts. Current CG Dynamics exact-client packet governs contacts/claims; do not freeze live business facts into an asset library.
Preserve exact keep/change/reject decisions, earlier approvals, people exclusions and MSI ownership. Never reset an unrelated approved element or amend another lane's project.

Owner-approved prior films are the client-specific comparison baseline. A new code recipe or technically passing export cannot silently replace that design standard. PSG's two approved films remain pinned reusable references.
rules.evidence_source: CA2Nov2026 PSG correction; approved PSG October/November records

rules.requirement: Map every screenshot or quoted-clip amendment to the exact sent revision, visible title/subject and output time/frame before editing. Verify the requested change on the new encoded target and its adjacent frames; a similar later scene does not clear the note.
rules.evidence_source: CA4Nov2026 Action Sports R15 missed held-ball B&W screenshot; protected R16 correction

rules.requirement: Define one buyer, useful message, three source-supported hooks, proof, payoff and CTA with relevant South African timing; do not build a generic montage first.
Use the exact authorised folders and source permissions. Screen full files and actual selected motion; do not use filenames, dates, hashes or contact sheets as a creative verdict.
Check actual source-month and later posted material through release. Old archives are allowed where suitable; do not repeat a published story or claim unused footage from partial checks.
rules.evidence_source: CA archive authorisation; TBS/Daisy prior-use failures; production-standard4–5

rules.requirement: Reject blur, focus/rack resets, camera jolts, empty pans, awkward performance and unwanted people. Preserve action setup/contact/payoff; do not shorten the same rejected moment and call it new.

Ehrlich and Action general films exclude camera-directed speaking; source chatter and crew direction are muted. Stock is illustrative, never represented as a client's people, premises, customers or results.
Verify each file's upright orientation before source-specific stabilisation. Stabilise ordinary camera footage by default; review original/corrected spans and final motion for crop/warp/subject loss.
Correct per-shot exposure and white balance, match adjacent shots, then style coherently. No blanket dark filter or claimed recovery of clipped highlights.

Central Canvas horizontal treatment uses three genuinely different moving clips filling the portrait bands with purposeful sequential reveals. No lone padded landscape shot or duplicated clip disguised as three.
rules.evidence_source: CA28Oct explicit lapa correction; shared rule909

rules.requirement: Portrait crops and motivated transitions preserve source geometry unless deliberate distortion is approved. Audit clone/pad frames in action shots; a hold must read as intentional, otherwise use continuing source motion or recut. Inspect the exact exported opener and ending span.
rules.evidence_source: CA4Nov2026 Action Sports R14 stretched feet crop and cloned MAKE IT COUNT tail; R15 corrected both

rules.requirement: Use the client's evidenced font/weight/substitute, colours, shapes and assets. Do not substitute convenient system fonts or infer a family from visual similarity. Approved substitutions stay explicit.

Design purposeful type reveals/animation and visual craft throughout the film, tied to actual content. Static PNGs, a delayed appearance or the logo animation alone do not demonstrate motion-design skill.
Each client's film has its own pace, motion language, sound and visual hierarchy. Compare the whole batch for repetition; different font filenames/music titles alone are not distinct direction.
rules.evidence_source: CA full-list unique-edit request; CA2Nov cover/type rejection

rules.requirement: Apply useful existing skill-library mechanisms with a plain control and protected revision; inspect actual exports/motion. Do not add an arbitrary effect quota or claim mastery from a mechanism proof.

Audit every rendered word, spelling, number, label, contact and crop against the approved copy inventory; inspect actual frames at phone size. Marketing screen text has no terminal full stops by default, with documented exact-text exceptions.
Select music with the story, audition the actual phrase/ending and verify commercial/platform rights. Catalogue mood/BPM, waveform, LUFS and muted playback are not musical-fit approval.

Consult the single shared used/rejected/reserved music ledger before a selection. Reject Cat Walk371, Gimme That Groove872 and exact rejected PSG cues; WiseRide Funkorama and Action Cipher are owner-rejected. Do not recycle another client's recent cue.
rules.evidence_source: CA Watch/lapa/PSG history and2Nov WiseRide/Action rejection

rules.requirement: Automotive and sporty/hyped sound must actually fit those brands. Playground/comedy/elevator-like choices are rejected. Do not claim TikTok trending or copyright-free status without exact discovery and commercial/platform licence proof.
rules.evidence_source: CA Watch music direction and2Nov WiseRide/Action sound rejection

rules.requirement: Music-led cuts land on audible beats or deliberately skipped beats across the film. Register any action/dialogue/SFX-led exceptions and recheck after picture or music revisions.

Build purposeful source-sound/music/SFX layers with separable stems and visible action sync. No unrelated foley, indiscriminate whooshes, crew chatter or source-logo sting. Review final tail, voice, mono and dynamics with actual sound.

Use the approved client logo animation, preserve its meaningful reveal/full mark, and mute its baked audio. WiseRide may use the explicitly authorised clean Wiseman Group animation. Do not use a watermarked or fabricated replacement.
rules.evidence_source: CA lapa mandatory outro; CA2Nov WiseRide fallback

rules.requirement: Design the outro for the portrait film using actual approved brand assets; simply dropping a small horizontal animation into empty padding is not sufficient creative effort. Never stretch/crop the official mark or invent a new logo.

Use the actual client Canva cover collection and approved artwork; new covers require relevant full-frame9:16 photography, exposure correction and legible product/title/logo in small centred3:4/4:5/square crops. No blurred bands or repeated generic scrim/title layout across clients.
rules.evidence_source: CA R01 cover rejection; reel-cover-and-instagram-audit.md; CA2Nov repeated-cover rejection

rules.requirement: Forwardable file message contains only the complete proposed post caption, in the exact-client voice and current approved contact/footer contract. No QA, revision notes, source URLs or licensing prose appended. Keep internal notes separate.
rules.evidence_source: standing delivery format; CA2Nov caption-only correction; CG Dynamics output contract

rules.requirement: Do not remove legally required music attribution while retaining the cue. Select commercially suitable music whose terms fit clean forwarding, or establish an explicitly permitted alternative credit arrangement; retain private licence proof.
rules.evidence_source: CA2Nov caption correction reconciled with actual licence obligations

rules.requirement: Resolve the exact configured production code, year/month and zero-padded video sequence. Verify the actual attachment filename and matching cover/caption stem; no CANDIDATE/descriptive basename presented as a production-ready forwardable file, invented code, overwritten final or duplicate production folder.

Review the entire exact export's picture, sound, typography, cover and spelling at normal speed and phone size through actual available review routes. Metering/decoding/muted browser completion are separate technical evidence. No invented hearing/phone/artistic approval.

Verify exact CG Nolan Approvals recipient; provide original MP4+caption and playable HD review media as required, separate caption-free HD image cover, then a separate signed Nolan Studio PC note. Witness HD and Sent/Delivered; preserve supersession and avoid unchanged duplicate media.
rules.evidence_source: CA phone-review correction and standing WhatsApp handoff

rules.requirement: Owner/internal review, client approval and publication are separate states. Preserve rejected files and sent evidence, block their resend, and never count delivery as approval. A generic send instruction does not silently waive missing creative evidence.

Preserve source/selection/effect recipes and separable assets. Native or cross-PC editability requires actual save/reopen/relink/export proof. Do not rebuild the engine or call baked graphics native text.

Finish current WIP safely and continue the assigned queue without duplicate renders or reminders replacing work. System repair first after this rejection, then one client/video at a time; no parallel batch rebuilds.
rules.evidence_source: CA continuation instructions and latest2Nov system-first correction

rules.requirement: Yield desktop control to humans and use file-based work while occupied. Leave Nolan's own0606307647 WhatsApp connected/open after authorised interactions; the old close instruction applied only to CA's personal account. Never restart/close the host ChatGPT app during active work. No WhatsApp feedback monitor, copied brain, unrelated sends or changed storage/account/security/hosting settings.
rules.evidence_source: CA5November explicit Nolan-own-account correction and host-app restart failure; AGENTS.md

rules.requirement: No spending, paid/API credits or external private-client-media uploads. Respect679 and current storage workers; internal SSD is cache/edit/render, originals remain in established OneDrive/external locations.
rules.evidence_source: CA repeated no-spend authority; AGENTS.md/679/storage runbook

rules.requirement: CA3Nov requires roughly30seconds for this batch. Check actual duration before delivery; no agent-created compact-cut exception, padded logo/holds or13second substitute.

Concrete viewer hook/useful purpose and meaningful brand-specific moving visual treatment required. NETBALL/BRINGYOURTEAM13sR08B is rejected. Asset provenance, title entrance,25tests and technical/model gates do not certify creative quality.
rules.evidence_source: CA3Nov purpose/hook/VFX rejection; prior creativePASS revoked

rules.requirement: CA5Nov requires UI animation in every video. Design and actually execute a brand-appropriate information interaction (focus, selection, progression, annotation or genuine UI state) with a visible story purpose; bind frames/components/operator/evidence. Never imply an invented client app or repeat the same dashboard across brands.
rules.evidence_source: CA5Nov2026 current motion-design/UI reference instruction; CA-MOTION-VOICE-UI-20261105.md

rules.requirement: For new production load reusable dated SouthAfrican monthly context, exact existing client approved baseline and actual Dynamics gameplan/state. Make explicit typography, composition/motion, transition, UI and sound decisions, carry selected mechanisms into the same story plan, and design an observable0–3s event/payoff rather than a poster. Approval updates both structured current records and readable notes; preserve later element-specific criticism. Do not reopen old approved films or reset brands.

For narrated films, develop a distinct South African brand voice as each brand is tackled. Reuse its approved profile/source after acceptance; retain rights/consent, locale, actual audio/script hashes and pronunciation/performance evidence. US engineering voices, ASR text or locale metadata alone are not South African voice approval.
